description: The hall configuration file for ivar: identity, providers, repos, integration defaults, skills, and MCP server definitions.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file.

integration.description: The hall's integration defaults: how features merge and what counts as verified.

strategy.description: How the child's commits land on the parent.

via.description: How the child's changes travel into the parent.

mcp.description: Hall-scoped MCP server definitions materialised by ivar sync.

oneOf.description: A remote MCP server reached over HTTP (SSE or streamable-http).

name.description: The server's name, unique within the hall's manifest.

oauth.description: A pre-provisioned OAuth client registration for servers whose host rejects dynamic client registration.

client_id.description: The client_id a registration issued. Not a secret.

client_secret_env.description: The name of the environment variable that holds the client secret at runtime.

type.description: Transport type: http for remote servers.

url.description: The URL the server is reached at. Must start with http:// or https://.

oneOf.description: A local MCP server spawned via stdio.

command.description: The executable to spawn. Must not be blank.

env.description: Environment variables. Values are references to env var names the harness resolves at runtime, not stored secrets.

name.description: The server's name, unique within the hall's manifest.

oauth.description: A pre-provisioned OAuth client registration for servers whose host rejects dynamic client registration.

client_id.description: The client_id a registration issued. Not a secret.

client_secret_env.description: The name of the environment variable that holds the client secret at runtime.

type.description: Transport type: local for servers spawned via stdio.

name.description: The hall's name: a single, non-empty, non-whitespace, non-traversal path segment.

providers.description: Which harnesses this hall knows about, and which one is the default.

available.description: Every provider id this hall knows about.

default.description: The provider ivar picks when none is named explicitly. Must appear in available.

repos.description: The repos this hall knows about.

checks.description: Ordered verification checks, run via 'bash -lc' in the worktree. Empty means no checks.

items.description: An executable command. Must not be blank.

default_branch.description: The branch a fresh worktree defaults to (e.g. 'main').

name.description: A unique, non-empty, single-segment identifier for this repo.

url.description: The git remote URL to clone from. Must not be empty.

skills.description: The hall's shared skill home, if it has one.

targets.description: Which harnesses this hall's shared skills materialise for.

title: ivar.json
